question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment can arise for a practitioner.
Yoginis hold dear one who possesses this accomplishment.
inference: A practitioner who attains great accomplishment in enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
